title: Numerical study of the sharp stratification limit towards bilayer models
summary: In the study of oceanic flows at the geophysical scale, the phenomenon of density stratification plays a central role in the dynamics of the system. Two categories of mathematical models are commonly used to describe the role played by the density stratification: on the one hand, continuously stratified models - such as the stratified Euler equations in a strip, considered in the present article - offer an accurate description of vertical effects, but come with a high level of complexity, both at the theoretical and numerical levels.
